title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
description: After a disastrous attempt to resurrect their deceased mother using the forbidden alchemy technique of human transmutation, young brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric pay a horrific price: Edward loses his left leg and right arm, while Alphonse's entire body is consumed, leaving his soul bound to a suit of armor. Determined to restore their bodies, Edward becomes a State Alchemist, and together the brothers embark on a quest across the country of Amestris to find the legendary Philosopher's Stone. Along their journey, they uncover a terrifying nation-wide conspiracy involving immortal Homunculi and a dark power threatening humanity itself.
genres: Action, Adventure, Dark Fantasy, Military, Drama
